faqSection.title: Everything You Need to Know Before Your Visit
faqSection.text: Clear answers to the most common questions from our patients about surgeries, consultations, and medical insurance.

items.q: Is microscopic brain and nerve surgery completely safe?
items.a: Yes, thanks to 3D neuronavigation and real-time neuromonitoring, safety rates are significantly higher and complications are minimized compared to traditional surgery.

items.q: How long is the recovery after endoscopic spine surgery?
items.a: In most cases, patients can walk the same day and return to desk work within one to two weeks, while strenuous physical activity requires 4-6 weeks.

items.q: Is surgery required immediately after a disc herniation diagnosis?
items.a: Not necessarily. We follow a gradual approach starting with conservative treatment and image-guided injections, resorting to surgery only when conservative treatment fails or progressive neurological weakness appears.

items.q: Do you work with health insurance companies?
items.a: Yes, we work with most locally and internationally accredited health insurance providers, and our reception team can help verify your policy coverage before your appointment.

items.q: Can patients outside Egypt get a remote consultation?
items.a: Absolutely. We offer initial video consultations to review scans and medical reports before planning your travel and treatment schedule.

items.q: What documents and tests are needed before the first visit?
items.a: We recommend bringing all previous scans (MRI or CT) along with medical reports and relevant lab results for an accurate assessment during your first consultation.

items.q: What's the difference between open surgery and minimally invasive surgery?
items.a: Minimally invasive surgery relies on very small incisions and precise endoscopes, reducing pain, bleeding, and hospital stay compared to traditional open surgery.

items.q: Do all disc herniation cases require surgery?
items.a: No, most cases respond to conservative treatment and physiotherapy; surgery is reserved for cases with neurological weakness or failed conservative treatment.

items.q: How long does it take to get imaging results and a diagnosis?
items.a: Scans are typically reviewed and an initial diagnosis is made during the same first consultation session.

items.q: Are there safe anesthesia options for elderly patients?
items.a: Yes, every case is assessed by a specialized anesthesia team to select the safest protocol based on age and overall health.

items.q: Can I get a second opinion?
items.a: Absolutely, we welcome reviewing reports and scans of previously diagnosed cases to provide an independent medical opinion.

items.q: What is the post-surgery follow-up process?
items.a: We set a clear schedule for follow-up appointments, checkups, and physiotherapy sessions if needed, to ensure the best possible recovery.

items.q: Is emergency service available around the clock?
items.a: Yes, a hotline for neurological emergencies is available 24/7.

items.q: Can I get a detailed medical report in English?
items.a: Yes, we provide all medical reports and correspondence in both Arabic and English to facilitate communication with insurance companies or overseas treatment centers.

hero.title: Privacy
hero.subtitle: How Dr. Sameh Qassem's clinic collects, uses, and protects your personal and medical information.

sections.title: Collection of Patient Data
sections.text: When you submit a booking request, contact us via WhatsApp, or fill out a form on this website, we may collect the following information to prepare for your consultation:
list: Full name and preferred contact number
Details of your medical history, symptoms, or condition that you choose to share
Medical reports, scans, or images you upload or send for review
Appointment preferences and clinic location

sections.title: Data Confidentiality & Protection
sections.text: All patient information is treated as strictly confidential in line with standard medical privacy practice. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal or medical data with any third party for marketing purposes.
list: Access to your records is limited to the doctor and authorized clinical staff directly involved in your care
Medical files and communications are stored securely and kept only for as long as necessary to provide follow-up care
Data is shared with an external party only when required by law or with your explicit consent, such as a referral to another specialist

sections.title: Direct WhatsApp Communication & Consultation Usage
sections.text: WhatsApp is offered as a convenient channel for initial questions, sending medical reports for review, and appointment coordination.
list: Messages and files sent over WhatsApp are used solely to assess your case and respond to your inquiry
An initial WhatsApp exchange does not replace an in-person medical examination or a documented consultation
Please avoid sharing sensitive financial information, such as full card numbers, over WhatsApp

sections.title: Cookies & Website Analytics
sections.text: This website uses cookies and similar technologies to remember your language preference and understand how visitors use our pages, so we can keep improving the experience.
list: Essential cookies keep the site functioning correctly, such as remembering your Arabic or English language choice
Analytics cookies provide anonymized statistics on page visits and do not identify you personally
You can disable cookies at any time from your browser settings; some features may then work less smoothly

sections.title: Patient Rights to Update or Delete Records
sections.text: You have the right to review, correct, or request deletion of the personal information you have shared with us.
list: Contact us by phone or email to request a copy of the data we hold about you
Ask us to correct any inaccurate personal details at any time
Request deletion of your contact and booking information, subject to any medical record-keeping obligations we are legally required to honor

privacyPolicy.contactNote: For any question about this policy or your personal data, please reach out to us.

hero.title: Medical Terms
hero.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before booking an appointment or using this website.

sections.title: Emergency Disclaimer
sections.text: This website and its booking forms are intended for scheduling consultations and are NOT a channel for critical or life-threatening medical emergencies.
list: If you are experiencing a medical emergency, such as a sudden severe headache, loss of consciousness, seizures, or major trauma, call emergency services or go to the nearest emergency room immediately
Do not rely on WhatsApp messages, contact forms, or booking requests for urgent situations — these are reviewed during clinic hours and are not monitored as an emergency line
For urgent neurological concerns during clinic hours, you may also reach the clinic directly by phone

sections.title: Educational Purpose of Website Content
sections.text: The articles, videos, and general information published on this website are provided for medical awareness and patient education only.
list: Content on this site does not constitute a diagnosis, medical advice, or a treatment plan for any individual case
Every patient's condition is different — a direct clinical examination by the doctor is required before any diagnosis or treatment decision
Do not delay seeking in-person medical care based solely on information read on this website

sections.title: Appointment Booking & Cancellation Policy
sections.text: To ensure fair access to appointment slots for all patients, please note the following booking terms:
list: Appointments booked through the website or WhatsApp are confirmed only after coordination with our clinic staff
We kindly request at least 24 hours' notice to reschedule or cancel an appointment
Repeated no-shows without notice may affect the ability to book future appointments
Please arrive with any relevant prior medical reports, scans, or imaging to make the most of your consultation time
